channel.title: Architecture on SigilGate
channel.description: Recent content in Architecture on SigilGate

item.title: Data Schemas
item.description: The etcd cluster is up and waiting for data. Here’s why copying everything over as-is didn’t work out — and how the migration turned into a full rethink of the data schemas.

item.title: The Management Cluster
item.description: First component: the management cluster on Kubernetes.

item.title: From a Clean Slate
item.description: Architecture 2.0 is taking shape — time to build. First component: a Kubernetes management cluster. But before any logic or services, there’s one question that comes first: security.

item.title: Architecture 2.0
item.description: Breaking down what was wrong with the old architecture and how I redesigned it: from a tree to two independent clusters, zero trust, one domain per cluster, and Docker-based onboarding.

item.title: Notes of a Surviving Lemming
item.description: Last autumn I lost my VPN. A story about the patterns that kill services, the arms race between regulators and protocols — and why all of it is ultimately about people.

item.title: Utopia
item.description: Why a private network is first and foremost a social structure, how it grows from the bottom up, and why freedom of communication should be a norm — not a privilege.

item.title: The Challenge of the Age
item.description: A prophetic article from Habr I couldn’t find again — and the arms race it predicted. From OpenVPN to statistical invisibility.

item.title: Data Storage System
item.description: The technical side of the project hasn’t been standing still — I structured the data, chose storage formats, and laid the groundwork for future automation.

item.title: KV Stores
item.description: What KV stores are, why they matter for distributed systems, and how etcd became the foundation of operational data storage in Sigil Gate.

item.title: The Data Storage System
item.description: Wanted to create a couple of user accounts — ended up designing a data storage system. A typical weekend.
